query:
UPDATE job_attempts
         SET finished_at = now(),
             outcome = $4::text::job_failure_kind,
             error_code = $5,
             error_message = $6,
             retry_delay_ms = $7,
             requested_retry_not_before = $8,
             effective_next_run_at = $9,
             retry_timing_source = $10
         WHERE job_id = $1
           AND run_number = $2
           AND attempt = $3
